issues.description: The LiPo battery is listed without a defined restraint, electrical protection, or routing that prevents lead pinching during shell assembly.
issues.fix: Specify a captive battery mount, protected electrical interface, strain relief, and clearance from moving or hot components; verify the complete pack and installation against applicable battery safety requirements.
issues.rule_citation: Assess lithium battery pack protection and installation safety — IEC 62133-2

issues.description: The specified self-tapping screws use a Ø2.2 boss pilot, but boss outer diameter, engagement length, and screw qualification in PA12-GF are undefined. Boss cracking or stripping could compromise the shell joint.
issues.fix: Specify boss geometry and engagement length; validate pilot size, assembly torque, and repeated assembly using production-moulded PA12-GF parts.
issues.rule_citation: Size and validate moulded screw bosses for the selected screw and resin — Protolabs injection molding design guide

issues.description: Both shells specify ±0.1 mm mating faces and a split-line step ≤ 0.1 mm, but no datum scheme or assembled tolerance stack is defined. The factory cannot determine which dimensions to control or inspect.
issues.fix: Define assembly datums and critical mating dimensions on drawings; calculate the shell, fastener, and seal stack-up before setting inspection limits.
issues.rule_citation: Dimension from functional datums and account for tolerance accumulation — ASME Y14.5

issues.description: The carbon-fibre folding arms are listed separately, but their hinge, retention, and load-transfer interfaces to the moulded shells are unspecified.
issues.fix: Define hinge hardware, stops, retention method, and reinforced load paths; validate arm joints under flight, landing, and repeated-fold loads.
issues.rule_citation: Provide defined fastening and load paths at assembled plastic-part interfaces — Protolabs injection molding design guide

issues.description: The kitesurf application exposes the shells, carbon-fibre joints, and black-zinc steel screws to UV and salt spray, but weathering performance and corrosion compatibility are unspecified.
issues.fix: Specify UV-stabilised enclosure material and corrosion-resistant fasteners and inserts; qualify assembled samples for salt exposure and galvanic corrosion at carbon-fibre interfaces.
issues.rule_citation: Evaluate materials and assemblies for salt-spray corrosion — ISO 9227

issues.description: No seal, drain, or pressure-equalisation approach is specified for the shell joint, camera, and electronics openings in a saltwater-use drone.
issues.fix: Define the enclosure sealing and drainage strategy, specify seals and compression features, and test the assembled product to a stated ingress-protection target.
issues.rule_citation: Classify and verify enclosure ingress protection — IEC 60529

issues.description: Minimum wall draft is 1.46°: enough for a polished finish, short of the ~3° a textured finish ('Matte · Graphite #3A3D42') needs.
issues.fix: Increase draft to 3° on textured faces, or specify a lighter texture / polished finish.
issues.rule_citation: Draft ≥1° plus 1° per 0.025 mm texture depth — Protolabs injection molding design guidelines; measured with text-to-cad DFM skill (mold_tool.py, MIT) ported to OCCT

measurement.label: measured
measurement.source_or_assumption: Min wall draft vs pull +Z: lowest-draft B-rep wall face ≥ 48.52 mm² (curved, 228.92 mm² at [-46.26, 22.26, 9.76]) — text-to-cad DFM skill (mold_tool.py, MIT) ported to OCCT

issues.description: Projected area along +Z: 6602 mm² (part silhouette, per cavity). Estimated clamp force ≈ 33.8 t (Estimate: area in² × 3.0 t/in² for PC/ABS × 1.1 safety) — per cavity; a family tool moulding both shells in one shot roughly doubles it.
issues.fix: Quote on a press ≥ 50 t; keep both shells in one family mould only if tonnage allows.
issues.rule_citation: Clamp force ≈ projected area × cavity-pressure factor (2-5 t/in²) — Protolabs injection molding design guidelines; silhouette raster from text-to-cad DFM skill (mold_tool.py, MIT) ported to OCCT

issues.description: The LiPo battery is listed without a defined restraint, electrical protection, or routing that prevents lead pinching during shell assembly.
issues.fix: Specify a captive battery mount, protected electrical interface, strain relief, and clearance from moving or hot components; verify the complete pack and installation against applicable battery safety requirements.
issues.rule_citation: Assess lithium battery pack protection and installation safety — IEC 62133-2

issues.description: The specified self-tapping screws use a Ø2.2 boss pilot, but boss outer diameter, engagement length, and screw qualification in PA12-GF are undefined. Boss cracking or stripping could compromise the shell joint.
issues.fix: Specify boss geometry and engagement length; validate pilot size, assembly torque, and repeated assembly using production-moulded PA12-GF parts.
issues.rule_citation: Size and validate moulded screw bosses for the selected screw and resin — Protolabs injection molding design guide

issues.description: Both shells specify ±0.1 mm mating faces and a split-line step ≤ 0.1 mm, but no datum scheme or assembled tolerance stack is defined. The factory cannot determine which dimensions to control or inspect.
issues.fix: Define assembly datums and critical mating dimensions on drawings; calculate the shell, fastener, and seal stack-up before setting inspection limits.
issues.rule_citation: Dimension from functional datums and account for tolerance accumulation — ASME Y14.5

issues.description: The carbon-fibre folding arms are listed separately, but their hinge, retention, and load-transfer interfaces to the moulded shells are unspecified.
issues.fix: Define hinge hardware, stops, retention method, and reinforced load paths; validate arm joints under flight, landing, and repeated-fold loads.
issues.rule_citation: Provide defined fastening and load paths at assembled plastic-part interfaces — Protolabs injection molding design guide

issues.description: The kitesurf application exposes the shells, carbon-fibre joints, and black-zinc steel screws to UV and salt spray, but weathering performance and corrosion compatibility are unspecified.
issues.fix: Specify UV-stabilised enclosure material and corrosion-resistant fasteners and inserts; qualify assembled samples for salt exposure and galvanic corrosion at carbon-fibre interfaces.
issues.rule_citation: Evaluate materials and assemblies for salt-spray corrosion — ISO 9227

issues.description: No seal, drain, or pressure-equalisation approach is specified for the shell joint, camera, and electronics openings in a saltwater-use drone.
issues.fix: Define the enclosure sealing and drainage strategy, specify seals and compression features, and test the assembled product to a stated ingress-protection target.
issues.rule_citation: Classify and verify enclosure ingress protection — IEC 60529

issues.description: Minimum wall draft is 1.46°: enough for a polished finish, short of the ~3° a textured finish ('Matte · Graphite #3A3D42') needs.
issues.fix: Increase draft to 3° on textured faces, or specify a lighter texture / polished finish.
issues.rule_citation: Draft ≥1° plus 1° per 0.025 mm texture depth — Protolabs injection molding design guidelines; measured with text-to-cad DFM skill (mold_tool.py, MIT) ported to OCCT

measurement.label: measured
measurement.source_or_assumption: Min wall draft vs pull +Z: lowest-draft B-rep wall face ≥ 48.52 mm² (curved, 228.92 mm² at [-46.26, 22.26, 9.76]) — text-to-cad DFM skill (mold_tool.py, MIT) ported to OCCT

issues.description: Projected area along +Z: 6602 mm² (part silhouette, per cavity). Estimated clamp force ≈ 33.8 t (Estimate: area in² × 3.0 t/in² for PC/ABS × 1.1 safety) — per cavity; a family tool moulding both shells in one shot roughly doubles it.
issues.fix: Quote on a press ≥ 50 t; keep both shells in one family mould only if tonnage allows.
issues.rule_citation: Clamp force ≈ projected area × cavity-pressure factor (2-5 t/in²) — Protolabs injection molding design guidelines; silhouette raster from text-to-cad DFM skill (mold_tool.py, MIT) ported to OCCT
